flavor.phonemic_palette: Fused Hellenic-Plains: Greek aspirates th/ph/kh and -os/-on/-es meet Plains open vowels and -wi/-ta; consonants p t k s sh h m n w y r l, glottal stop; fused endings -ios/-wios/-os on open Plains roots.
flavor.phenotype_notes: Synthesis of Greek + Plains-nomad per setting-lore §5.3 (blend the listed features; exclude the inverse).

magic_attitude.notes: Greek + Plains-nomad register; deity-morphs in name_bank 'thracan'.

religion_hooks.alignment_lens: Resolved per the culture's chosen alignment (setting-lore §4.2): Lawful venerates the 12 Lawful powers and names the 13 as demons; Chaotic venerates the 13 and names the 12 as tyrant-gods; Neutral venerates this culture's ancestral saints, invoking the great gods only situationally.

flavor_text.one_line: Thracan — wary egalitarian of the grassland; freedom, glory.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Thracan (Greek + Plains-nomad) are a expansionist egalitarian people seeded in grassland, scrubland. They prize freedom, glory, knowledge, lean toward the military sphere, and field heavy_infantry, light_cavalry, archers. Outsiders are met as wary; their patrons touch war, nature, knowledge.
